title: 第23章 矿脉暴动第24章 血魔真功
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 第二天。
矿山上的矿奴们在监工与守卫的鞭策下正热火朝天的开采着矿石，一车车刚刚开采出来的矿石被送到了堆料场。
“动作给我放快点，说你呢，磨磨唧唧的，不要命了？”
一个肥胖的监工挥舞着手中的鞭子指着一名中年矿奴怒喝道，他的身后，跟着两名守卫。
那中年矿奴深深的看了他一眼，随即加快了速度。
然而肥胖监工却被他看的有些不爽了。
不知为啥，刚刚那卑贱矿奴看他的时候，他的心中竟然生出了一丝胆怯，这是他不能容忍的。
他气冲冲的向着中年矿奴走了过去。
的一声，手中的鞭子狠狠的抽在了中年矿奴的后背上。
直接抽的中年矿奴身子一个趔趄，那裸露出来的黝黑后背上，顿时多出了一条猩红的血痕。
“你有几条命？敢瞪我？”
肥胖监工挥舞着手中的鞭子狞笑着道。
矿奴暗自攥紧了拳头，因为攥的太过用力，骨关节都有些发白了。
他深吸了一口气，想要发作。
但不知是想到了什么，攥紧的拳头悄然松开。
“监工大人，我是个浑人，请你不要跟我一般见识。”
矿奴低头道。
“哼，爷爷今天心情好，这次就饶过你了，再有下次，小心你的狗命。”
肥胖监工皮笑肉不笑的道。
说完。
便带着两名手下扬长而去。
看着肥胖监工那小山一般的背影，矿奴的眼中，尽是阴霾。
另一边，走远的监工几人。
一名守卫笑着调侃监工道：“虎哥，你今天怎么突然一副菩萨心肠了，若是搁以前，这小子敢跟你横，怕是已经小命不保了。”
监工闻言，冷哼了一声道：
“算这狗东西运气好，上面来通知了，这两天，主家有一位大人物要来矿山巡视，让我们老实本分些。”
“大人物？”
守卫眼前一亮。
赶忙追问道：“虎哥，你一向神通广大，消息灵通，可知道是哪位大人物要来？”
对这句话，监工非常受用，他笑的眼睛都眯成了一条缝。
他指着头顶上的天。
低声道：“顶了天的大人物。”
守卫瞬间了然，猛的倒吸了一口凉气。
“不要出去乱说，知道吗？”
监工瞥了他一眼道。
守卫咧嘴一笑：“虎哥，你还不知道我吗？嘴上出了名的有把锁。”
监工不屑的嗤笑了一声。
几人嘻嘻哈哈的走远了。
远处。
content_en:
the next day.
Under the urging of supervisors and guards, the slaves in the mine were mining the ore enthusiastically, and cartloads of the newly mined ore were sent to the stockpile.
"Move faster, what about you, you are grinding and whining, are you going to die?"
A fat overseer waved the whip in his hand and pointed at a middle-aged mine slave and shouted angrily. Behind him, two guards followed.
The middle-aged mining slave looked at him deeply and then accelerated his speed.
However, the fat supervisor was a little unhappy when he saw him.
For some reason, when the humble mine slave looked at him just now, he felt a hint of timidity in his heart, which he couldn't tolerate.
He angrily walked towards the middle-aged mining slave.
"Pa"
With a sound, the whip in his hand hit the middle-aged mining slave hard on the back.
The middle-aged mine slave who was slapped staggered, and a scarlet bloodstain suddenly appeared on his exposed dark back.
"How many lives do you have? Dare you stare at me?"
The fat overseer waved the whip in his hand and said with a grin.
The mine slave secretly clenched his fists, because he clenched them so hard that his bones and joints turned white.
He took a deep breath and wanted to have a seizure.
But I don't know what I thought of, and my clenched fists quietly unclenched.
"Master overseer, I am a fool, please don't be the same as me."
The mine slave lowered his head and said.
"Hmph, grandpa is in a good mood today. I will let you off this time. Next time, be careful about your life."
The fat overseer said with a smile.
Finished.
Then he took his two men and walked away.
Looking at the fat overseer's hill-like back, the mine slave's eyes were full of gloom.
On the other side, several supervisors walked away.
.......
One of the guards laughed and teased the supervisor: "Brother Tiger, why did you suddenly become a Bodhisattva today? If it had been before, if this kid dared to fight with you, I'm afraid his life would have been in danger."
When the supervisor heard this, he snorted coldly and said:
"This bitch is lucky. We've been notified from above that a big shot from the master's family is coming to inspect the mine in the next two days. Let's do our duty honestly."
"Big shot?"
The guard's eyes lit up.
He quickly asked: "Brother Hu, you have always been very powerful and well-informed, but do you know which big shot is coming?"
The supervisor was very impressed by this sentence, and his eyes narrowed into slits when he smiled.
He pointed to the sky above his head.
He said in a low voice: "A great man who can stand up to the sky."
The guard understood instantly and took a deep breath.
"Don't go out and talk nonsense, you know?"
The overseer glanced at him and said.
The guard grinned: "Brother Tiger, don't you know me yet? I'm notorious for having a lock on my mouth."
The overseer sneered disdainfully.
Several people walked away laughing.
far away.
